css-epub-hyphens.note: The content agent restates each prefixed declaration with its unprefixed equivalent, so the property reaches the computed style; the rendering it then produces is the browser's.

css-epub-text-combine-horizontal.note: The content agent restates each prefixed declaration with its unprefixed equivalent, so the property reaches the computed style; the rendering it then produces is the browser's. Both the current and the deprecated `-epub-text-combine` spelling map onto `text-combine-upright`.

css-epub-text-emphasis.note: The content agent restates each prefixed declaration with its unprefixed equivalent, so the property reaches the computed style; the rendering it then produces is the browser's. Chromium serializes `text-emphasis-position` as its block side only, so left and right are not distinguished here.

css-epub-text-orientation.note: The content agent restates each prefixed declaration with its unprefixed equivalent, so the property reaches the computed style; the rendering it then produces is the browser's. The deprecated `vertical-right`, `rotate-right` and `rotate-normal` keywords map onto `mixed` and `sideways`.

css-epub-text-transform.note: The agent maps the prefixed value (the observed `style` attribute carries `text-transform: full-width` after it), but Chromium does not implement `text-transform: full-width`, so the computed value stays `none`.

css-epub-text-underline-position.note: The content agent restates each prefixed declaration with its unprefixed equivalent, so the property reaches the computed style; the rendering it then produces is the browser's. The deprecated `alphabetic` keyword maps onto `auto`.
